ev_0006.summary: Triangle ABC has vertices A=(519.97,97.84), B=(72.56,628.78), C=(662.12,629.28), with base BC horizontal (seg_02, snapped to B and C). Sides AB (seg_01) and AC (seg_03) reach A and their ends overshoot B/C by under 10 px, so they are snapped to the vertices. seg_04 is the line through B and O (passes O within 0.3 px) and extends about 9 px past O; seg_06 is the line through C and O (passes O within about 0.5 px) and extends about 26 px past O to (503.4,444.5). So BO and CO are cevians meeting at O. seg_05 is a vertical at x=520 through A and O (A at y=97.8, O at y=464.3), extended about 12 px below O to y=476; its foot on BC would be H=(520,629), which is not drawn. AO is perpendicular to BC by coordinates (vertical vs horizontal), but detect_right_angle_marker found no square mark, so no right_angle object is submitted and the perpendicular relation is only a candidate. O does not lie on BC, so the claim that the altitude foot is O is contradicted by the evidence.
